title: My friend and I have been to the same dream location?
content: I made a post about this and was directed here. I've never heard of the "mall world" so this is pretty interesting to me. There are several dream places I return to multiple times. Sometimes they change slightly but I always know it's the same place. My best friend and I went out for coffee and were talking about dreams we have and the places we've been to multiple times. During this, we realized we've been to the same dream "location." In my dreams, it's a city that is supposed to be NYC. The buildings are mainly brick or concrete, and I always know my way around it. It looks kind of like a morph of actual NYC and the city we live in. There is one specific street that I always go to. It's like an alley and is cobble stoned. One side is usually a bunch of arcades, theaters, etc. and the other side is shops. I specifically go to this shop that is sometimes a "witchy/spiritual" store and sometimes is also a thrift store. An old woman is usually the shopkeeper. Her hair is white and cut in a pixie style. Shes short and a little plump. I can never make out her face clearly. Shes always nice though when shes there. When I was describing this to my friend, she looked shocked and said she's dreamed of the same place. It's always meant to be NYC, and she knows how to get around and she also has been on a cobble stone alley lined with similar buildings. This is the only cobble stone alley in the city in both our dreams. We don't have any streets like that in our city so it's weird because this is so specific. Has anyone had this experience with someone else? It's like we've gone to the same dream "world." We've never seen each other when we're there though and we're both usually there alone (there are other random people around in the dream, though). It's just really weird, and I'm wondering if anyone has been to the same fictional dream setting as someone else.
